verdict.rationale: The public pages link a CCFS Search for business records and an Apostille Search, and they refer to business 'Active Status'. A founder can likely look up entity records and status from public pages. The evidence is only link titles, though, and nothing shows that pending filings, applications, or cases can be tracked. Missing for 10: documented status tracking for submitted filings or applications, a description of what the CCFS/Apostille search results show, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
